days_meaning: each delivery day adds this much cash to your side

messages.text: Hello, and thank you for meeting me. I would propose 63 P with delivery on day 0.
I appreciate it, thank you. Could we close at 71 P, delivery on day 0, please?
Fair enough, thank you. I will meet you partway: 74 P with delivery on day 0.
Thank you, we are getting close. 77 P and delivery on day 0 works for me.
